name: Steve Ballmer

lifetimeGiving.source: Forbes profile editor's note: 'to date the Ballmers have given away more than $7.4 billion'

onTheRecord.finding: Forbes (Oct 20, 2024, updated Apr 2025): Ballmer has put over $100 million into USAFacts, a nonpartisan government-data website he founded in 2017, and confirmed spending over $40 million in the 2024 election year 'to get the facts out'; Forbes says his wife Connie is the family's political donor, giving $1.25 million to groups supporting Kamala Harris in the 2024 cycle and over $14 million to liberal groups 2019-2022 per FEC filings. Forbes estimates the couple's philanthropy at more than $4 billion over the past decade.

notes: Forbes profile (as of Sep 27, 2026): $160.2B, #9 in the world, Philanthropy Score 2, citizenship United States, source Microsoft (self-made); editor's note says the Ballmers have given away more than $7.4B to date (secondary; Forbes's own estimate, no underlying document seen). Giving Pledge: Ballmer does not appear on the official pledger-list page (checked Sep 27, 2026). Foundation: the Ballmers give through Ballmer Group, which is not a private foundation; ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer searches for 'ballmer group' and 'ballmer' (1,631 fuzzy results, first page reviewed) returned no Ballmer-named 501(c)(3) private foundation, so no 990-PF assets/grants/payout data are on file under that name; EIN left blank; filesUS990PF=false reflects that no such filing was found, not a confirmed legal structure.
